pc_thinning_report — 3D resolution op

• Data kinds: points × points → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.pc_thinning_report(points, thinned, k=8, radius=None) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import meshres; meshres.pc_thinning_report(points, thinned, k=8, radius=None), registry से लेना हो तो ops3d.get("pc_thinning_report"))

उपयोग

point-cloud thinning ने क्या हटाया, और क्या उसने दुर्लभ points को छुआ (table)।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

removed count and fraction; removed_spacing percentiles of the local spacing (pc_density) of the removed points versus kept_spacing; isolated_removed counts removed points whose nearest-neighbour distance exceeded *radius* (default: the 95th percentile of nearest-neighbour distances) — a thinning that removed such points has discarded exactly the rare, isolated observations a survey exists to find (pc_poisson_disk with the same radius removes none of them, by construction); max_gap is the largest distance from any removed point to the kept cloud (the biggest hole the thinning made).

पृष्ठभूमि guides (इस op के पीछे की physics और conventions)

• depth_sensors — Depth sensors — ranging के सिद्धांत, असली devices के आँकड़े, dropouts कैसे दिखते हैं
